title: A group's pack ranker, named as extension point ranker, adds one ranked list that kbfacts.rrf fuses, and with none set every pack is byte for byte as before
goal: kbfacts.pack calls the ranker extensions.ranker names as rank(question, candidates) with the candidate articles' qualified paths; kbfacts.rrf fuses the list it returns as one more expert so an article it puts first ranks no lower than without it; a path it returns that is no candidate is dropped; an exception or an answer that is no list leaves the pack as without a ranker and prints one stderr line naming the point; with no ranker set rag.py eval's held-out results are unchanged

clauses.clause: kbfacts.pack calls the ranker extensions.ranker names as rank(question, candidates) with the candidate articles' qualified paths
kbfacts.rrf fuses the list it returns as one more expert so an article it puts first ranks no lower than without it
a path it returns that is no candidate is dropped
an exception or an answer that is no list leaves the pack as without a ranker and prints one stderr line naming the point
with no ranker set rag.py eval's held-out results are unchanged

notes: Check 2 (the held-out eval) passes before the work: with no ranker set the pack must rank as it does now.
